text:
mira: Alright team, urgent cultural imperative: megawave sticker drop. Post your most absurd animated sticker. One post only. :sunglasses:

alejandro: https://media.giphy.com/media/3oEdv5QH1kQj1k5aJ2/giphy.gif :taco:

fin: dropping: tiny-astronaut-sips-coffee.gif (no idea where I found this) :space_invader: :coffee:

zoe: uploads a 2-frame pixel pigeon that blinks aggressively :dove_of_peace: :eyes:

sticker-bot: auto-posted: "Featured sticker: neon-bread-bounce.gif" (link: https://cdn.example.com/neon-bread-bounce.gif) :bread::sparkles:

alejandro: reacts with :laughing: to fin

mira: reacts with :trophy: to zoe

fin: @mira is this a judged competition or merely chaos?

mira: Judge of chaos. Vote by reacting to the original message: :one: alejandro, :two: fin, :three: zoe. Loser must post an embarrassing childhood GIF in #lunch-plans tomorrow. :grimacing:

zoe: reaction-only reply: :three:

alejandro: reaction-only reply: :one: :tada:

fin: reaction-only reply: :two: :clown_face:

mira: also posts a follow-up: please no bread puns. Unless exceptional. :pleading_face:
